rules: Twenty-seven measured regions resolve to seventeen rows - fourteen plates and three grids - plus ten exclusions; two further exhibits, Tables 2 and 5, own no measured box, so nineteen exhibits print and seventeen are measured [place.area_frac]

Four families cover all fourteen plates - eight line charts, three schematics, two photo collages and ONE bar chart - so the visual language is plotted more than drawn; not one scatter, box plot, heat map, node-link network, map or 3-D surface on the paper [geometry.family]
Every plate prints BELOW its artwork and every measured grid prints its caption ABOVE, so caption side is decided by media, not by house style [caption.position]

Seven of fourteen plates print numbers, and they print them as AXIS TICKS rather than as labels on the marks; the three schematic plates tick their axes with symbols only (N, N/2, x0) [geometry.printed_numbers]
Six of fourteen plates key their series INSIDE the frame - one key box overlaps the plot and names four of the five series it draws - and eight print no key at all [geometry.legend]

Four plates are side-by-side (a)/(b) pairs: the sub-captions print between the panels and the numbered caption, and each row boxes only its left panel, so the right panel is excluded as fragment-of-other [geometry.panel_count] [geometry.panel_layout]

Exactly one plate is drawn in depth, Figure 2's carbon-cycle slab in isometric projection with the axes drawn as arrowheads; nothing measured carries a colour bar [geometry.three_d] [geometry.colorbar]

All three measured grids are booktabs - horizontal rules only, no vertical stroke - fill the text column, print in portrait, and stand 3 to 7 rows tall by 2 to 5 columns wide [table.rule_style] [table.width] [table.rows]

No grid carries zebra striping, a merged cell, a diagonal header, units in the header row, a note row or a continuation onto another page; units print INSIDE the cells of Table 4's last column [table.units_in_header] [table.merged_cells] [table.continued]

No measured grid aligns its decimals: Table 1 is all text, Table 3 mixes 80 against 0.4 in one column and Table 4 mixes symbolic 'Z_i1 = 0' cells against 0.3 and '3USD / m3' [table.decimal_aligned] [table.numeric_cols]

Caption numbering is unpunctuated and unspaced - 'Fig.1' to 'Fig.14' and 'Table 1' to 'Table 5' - so the number runs straight into the noun phrase with no colon and no period, and the prose copies the same habit [caption.numbering] [mention.style]

Fourteen captions run one sentence and three run two; the three long ones are exactly the three that explain a drawing convention or state a relation, and only Figure 6's caption draws a conclusion ('The higher the carbon stock, the higher the amount of wood cut') [caption.sentences] [caption.concludes]

No caption names a unit, a named variable or a condition. Fifteen of seventeen are bare noun phrases; the only finite verbs in the whole set sit in the second sentence of Figures 5 and 7 ('Grey shading shows...', 'Gray shading indicates...'), which are legend notes rather than description, so no caption is marked active or passive [caption.units] [caption.variables] [caption.voice]
All fourteen pointed rows use the same locative 'as shown in' clause; not one pointer makes the exhibit its subject [mention.lead_pattern] [mention.lead_sentence]
Three plates are never named in prose - Figures 1, 8 and 10, one schematic and two photo collages - so a fifth of the plates reach the reader with no sentence introducing them [mention.count]

Two plates are cited ONLY after they print, by the paragraph that reads them (Figures 6 and 14), and one plate is announced a page early - Figure 7's announcing sentence closes p9 while the plate opens p10 [mention.trail_sentence] [mention.lead_pages]
